extensionDescription.message: Imports a FoxyProxy configuration (modern and legacy formats, incl. foxyproxy.xml) and automatically creates Firefox containers, assigning a matching proxy to each container. Exports the assigned proxies back into FoxyProxy config formats.

importHint.message: Choose a FoxyProxy configuration file (JSON from FoxyProxy 6+ or XML from FoxyProxy 4.x), or drag it here. Containers and proxies will be created automatically.

dropHint.message: …or drag a FoxyProxy config file and drop it here

exportHint.message: Export the proxies assigned to your containers into a FoxyProxy configuration file. Each button opens a save dialog. Exports always use the CURRENT container names and colors. The modern file carries BOTH FoxyProxy formats: import it with the main “Import” button on the FoxyProxy “Import” tab (then press Save) OR via “Import from older versions” — either dialog works. The legacy file is imported via “Import from older versions”.

statusConflict.message: Warning: proxy settings are controlled by %s. This may override the proxies of this extension. Open about:addons and disable the conflicting extension, or reset the browser proxy settings to “Use system proxy settings”.

conflictManualSettings.message: manual proxy settings in the browser

conflictGeneric.message: another extension or manual browser settings

statusContainersChanged.message: Container list changed (rename/color/removal). Exports will use the current container names.

statusNoProxies.message: No proxy servers found in the file. Supported formats: FoxyProxy 8+/9+ export (data), FoxyProxy 6.x–7.5.1 export (proxySettings), FoxyProxy 6.x storage backup, or FoxyProxy 4.x foxyproxy.xml.

statusOnlySkipped.message: All %s entries are direct/PAC — nothing to import.

statusFound.message: Found %1$s proxies (%2$s direct/PAC entries will be skipped). Creating containers…

statusDone.message: Done! Containers created: %s. Proxies assigned automatically.

statusBadXml.message: The XML file could not be parsed.

statusUnavailable.message: Import failed: background context is unavailable.

statusExportEmpty.message: Nothing to export: no proxies are assigned to containers yet. Import a configuration first.

statusExportDone.message: Export finished: %s proxies written to the file.

statusExportCancelled.message: Export cancelled: the save dialog was closed.

notifyStart.message: Import started: creating containers for %s proxies…

notifyDone.message: Import finished: %1$s containers created, %2$s entries skipped.

notifyConflict.message: Proxy settings are controlled by %s — this may override the container proxies. See the import page for details.

notifyBindingRemoved.message: Container “%s” was removed — its proxy binding was deleted.
